message: プレゼント

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san is...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Doesn't she feel unwell every now and then?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, true. Plus, she's been getting awfully worked up lately.」

name: Ria
message: 「But what does that have to do with Re-Crea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you see,」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President.」
I locked eyes with Lolotte and gave a firm nod.

name: Synn
message: 「To tell you the truth, I--」

name: Helena
message: 「I see, so that's how it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't be a stranger. If you'd just talked to me, I'd have come running anytime.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-You mustn't come any closer!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, looks like someone stole Ria's job.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. We're having an important talk right now, so don't interrupt.」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't be so cold. We've been worried about Azel-chan too, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, we can't just leave things like this. It'd be awful if it gets too late.」

name: Misa
message: 「Um... we still don't know what's going on at all, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「Right you are! Solving everyone's troubles! Tell us, Headmaster~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uhh, are we being left behind here?」

name: Helena
message: 「I know someone who's well-versed in this sort of thing, so I'll go ask them.」

name: Helena
message: 「'Leave your back to me.'」
Helena pushed the conversation forward on her own, then left the Student Council room just like that.

name: Synn
message: 「Someone else who knows about it besides Helena...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is a new comrade making an appearance right now~~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. I have no idea what's going on at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「She's right. Even about what Sakura-kun was about to say earlier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? U-Uhh... That's--」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, right. Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah!!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sorry for the sudden notice, but we found a contractor to do the Christmas decorations. Could you go greet them right now?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't mind, but...」
Grrr, when am I supposed to steel my resolve?

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sorry. For interrupting.」
Could it be that Helena noticed what I'm trying to do?

name: Helena
message: 「You were just about to start making costumes for the costume party, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that's right.」
...Guess I was just overthinking it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I'll go with him too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave the rest to me and the President, and everyone else just stretch your necks like a rokurokubi while you wait, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「She's not wrong, though...\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「Mhm, mhm. How reliable. Well then, I'll leave it to the two of you.」

name: Helena
message: 「And also--」

name: Helena
message: 「Stay by Azel-chan's side as much as you can. Please.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sorry. I'll explain the details tomorrow.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, everyone! I wish you all the best of luck.」
Just how much does Helena-san actually know?
We settled on asking for help with the large-scale decorations, while the students would handle everything else.
So, we decided to take a stroll through the shopping district to get some ideas for the decorations.
With a cheerful Lolotte.
And a quiet Azel.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, bringing Azel-san along--that's quite sharp of you, President~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... it wasn't me, it was Helena-san. She told me to stay close to her as much as possible.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably because it'd be bad if she collapsed again... or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel?!」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm going back.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, that won't do. You mustn't abandon your duties halfway through.」

name: Azel
message: 「This has nothing to do with me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san is already a member of the Student Council, after all ♪」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I never agreed to--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! Amazing, look at that!」
Azel's protests were in vain, as Lolotte's attention had already been drawn to something else.

name: Synn
message: 「Christmas is right around the corner, after all.」
The entire shopping district was decked out in Christmas colors, with various decorations adorning the eaves of every shop.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. So Christmas isn't something celebrated only at Ryuusei Academy~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I came here, it was right after Christmas had ended, so this is my first time seeing it~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's your first time seeing it too, right, Azel-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if Re-Crea is involved?」

name: Azel
message: 「And you thought that meager bait would hook me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shallow creatures, as always.」
I hoped I could get a little closer to unraveling Azel's mystery, though I guess I was way too direct.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, the shops are especially lively, aren't they? Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's probably Christmas sales.」

name: Synn
message: 「In the Human World, there's a tradition of giving presents on Christmas. So stores hold special sales to go along with it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. Presents, is it~」

name: Synn
message: 「To family, friends, close acquaintances, people who've helped you out... and also...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are there other people you give presents to as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... giving a present to someone you like is probably the most common.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Someone... you like...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, is there anything you'd like as a present?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I'd be happy with anything I get!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That makes it hard to choose, though~」
Gah! Blowing a golden opportunity like that...!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, what about you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「A present...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. After all, you're my friend, Azel♪」
Ugh...... So she still just sees me as a friend, same as Azel......

name: Lolotte
message: 「Memories may be important, too. Even so, I think giving something tangible that lasts is also a wonderful thing.」

name: Azel
message: 「Something tangible that lasts. So that's what a present is.」

name: Azel
message: 「Something like that...」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that doesn't help me narrow it down at all~~!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I see. Since you're clueless about these things, Azel-san, you simply don't know what kind of options exist, do you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, let's go window shopping together. I'm sure you'll find something you want if we do.」

name: Azel
message: 「H-Hey, stop it...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Onward! Charge into the shops~♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Aaaah--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」
I'd really love to get Lolotte a present for Christmas too.
